name: How can I prevent future toilet flange damage after repair?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future toilet flange damage after repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent future toilet flange damage, ensure the toilet is properly installed and secured firmly to the floor, without overtightening the bolts. Use a high-quality wax ring or a foam gasket for a durable seal. Regularly check for any signs of leaks around the toilet base, addressing them promptly to prevent water from compromising the flange or subfloor. Additionally, avoid excessive rocking or pressure on the toilet, which can stress the flange over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent damage by ensuring proper toilet installation, using quality seals, addressing leaks promptly, and avoiding excessive stress on the toilet.
